2. **Area Calculation**: Multiply the pixel count of each region by the GSD squared (0.523² = 0.2735 m²/pixel).

For example, if a region has 10,000 pixels:
$$
\text{Area} = 10,000 \times 0.2735 = 2,735 \, \text{m}^2
$$
